key_insight: A Gemini-based agent autonomously discovered and formally verified compact, Collatz-like execution rules for eleven BB(6) Turing machines without resolving their halting behavior.
engineering_relevance: The work demonstrates a workflow for turning AI-generated patterns into machine-checked mathematical results in an open-ended computational domain.
method: Recognize patterns in Turing-machine execution and conjecture compact acceleration rules.
Use informal mathematical reasoning to develop candidate proofs.
Formally verify the acceleration rules in Lean.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports novel, formally verified accelerations for eleven BB(6) machines, provisionally classified as Cryptids pending community acceptance.
watch_item: Verified acceleration rules do not establish whether these machines halt, and the abstract provides no aggregate success rate or computational cost.
paper_title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
